label: 12-literature
question: Is there published literature on file about AI radiology software failures? Cite PMIDs.
answer: Yes, stored literature includes AI radiology studies, including PMID 35943350 on false-negative and false-positive outcomes of computer-aided detection for brain metastasis and PMID 32531273 on AI for breast cancer detection in mammography. Stored files also include PMID 31594798, a systematic review of AI to diagnose ischemic stroke and identify large vessel occlusions, and PMID 37541274, a clinical safety analysis of AI-supported screen reading in mammography screening.
